components.name: Available for manual enrollment / trigger
components.description: To be used in manual enrollment / trigger
components.summary: Starts the playbook when a user enrolls an entity by hand, from the entity view or in bulk from a list.
components.use_when: an analyst should decide which entities go through the playbook. The filters decide on which entities the playbook is offered.

see_also.label: Run a playbook on selected entities

components.name: Listen knowledge events
components.description: Listen for all platform knowledge events
components.summary: Starts the playbook on every knowledge event (creation, update or deletion) that matches the filters.
components.use_when: the playbook must react to data as it arrives, for example to enrich every new indicator, or to act when a label is added.
notes: Filters on this component accept two extra operators, "has changed" and "has not changed", to react to a change of one property such as a status or a score.
Only the filters available for stream events that carry STIX objects can be used.

components.name: Listen PIR events
components.description: Listen for all internal PIR events

fields.label: A new entity enters a selected PIR
An entity has left a selected PIR
An entity from a selected PIR has been updated
An entity is linked to an entity from a selected PIR

components.summary: Starts the playbook on events of the Priority Intelligence Requirements (PIR) you select. When no PIR is selected, events of every PIR are processed.
components.use_when: you want to act when an entity enters or leaves a PIR, is updated while in it, or gets linked to an entity of the PIR.
notes: Combine with a PIR score filter to react only to highly relevant entities. The "has changed" and "has not changed" operators are available here too.

components.name: Query knowledge on a regular basis
components.description: Query knowledge on the platform

fields.label: Only last modified entities after the last run
Include all entities in a single bundle

components.summary: Queries knowledge on a schedule (every minute, hour, day, week or month) and runs the playbook on the matching entities.
components.use_when: the result should be periodic, such as a weekly digest, rather than event by event.
notes: Turn on "Include all entities in a single bundle" to send one notification or one email covering every match instead of one per entity.

components.name: Log data in standard output
components.description: Print bundle in platform logs
components.summary: Writes the bundle to the platform logs at the chosen level, then passes it on unchanged.
components.use_when: you debug a playbook and need to see the exact bundle at a given step on the server side.

components.name: Send for ingestion
components.description: Send STIX data for ingestion
components.summary: Writes the bundle to the knowledge base. Without this step, nothing the playbook changed is saved.
components.use_when: always, at the end of every branch that changes data.

components.name: Match knowledge
components.description: Match STIX data according to filter (pass if match)

ports.meaning: at least one element was changed or matched

fields.label: Match on any elements included in the bundle

components.summary: Lets the bundle continue only if at least one element matches the filters. Use the no-match output to handle the other case.
components.use_when: you need a condition, for example to treat high-score indicators differently from the others.

components.name: Enrich through connector
components.description: Use a registered platform connector for enrichment
components.summary: Sends the bundle to an enrichment connector registered on your platform and continues with the enriched bundle.
components.use_when: you need data from an external source (reputation, WHOIS, sandbox) in the middle of a playbook.
notes: The step fails if an element does not match the connector scope. Remove incompatible elements first with Reduce knowledge, or route them by type with Match knowledge.
The step can also stop when the external source has no record for the observable.

components.name: Manipulate knowledge
components.description: Manipulate STIX data

ports.meaning: at least one element was changed or matched
nothing was changed and the bundle passes through as received

fields.label: Manipulate all elements included in the bundle

components.summary: Adds, replaces or removes values of attributes (labels, markings, score, author) on the elements in scope.
components.use_when: you set or clean attributes automatically, for example to label everything a feed creates.
notes: Add appends values, replace overwrites the whole set, remove deletes only the listed values.
When an enrichment connector follows this step, its changes and yours are both kept in the final write.
From 7.261109, the Field list also offers the custom fields of the platform, by their label. Replace and remove work on every custom field; add only on a multiple selection list, option by option.
From 7.261117, the Field list also offers Report types, with add, replace and remove. Its values come from the report types vocabulary, and only reports in scope are changed.

From 7.261119, replacing the Status asks for an Entity type first, then lists only the statuses of that type's workflow. The step sets the status on the elements of that type and leaves the other types untouched. A Status action saved before 7.261119 has no entity type and still applies to every element in scope.

components.name: Container wrapper
components.description: Create a container and wrap the element inside it

fields.label: Wrap all elements included in the bundle
Copy files from main element to the container
Create a new container at each run

components.summary: Puts the elements of the bundle in a container (report, grouping, case) of the type you choose.
components.use_when: you turn matching data into an analyst work item, for example a case created from an incident.
notes: Choosing a case type unlocks case templates, which create the case with its tasks.
By default the playbook keeps filling the same container on later runs. Turn on "Create a new container at each run" to get one container per run.
When the main element is an incident wrapped into a case, the case reuses its author, labels, assignees, participants, title, markings and, when the value exists for cases, its severity.

components.name: Security coverage
components.description: Create a security coverage for the given entity(ies) (when type is compatible)

fields.label: Create a security coverage for each element of the bundle (on compatible types)
Force manual coverage (prevent enrichment connectors from running)

components.summary: Creates a security coverage for each compatible element in scope and adds it to the bundle, so OpenAEV can test your defenses against it.
components.use_when: you want threats that reach OpenCTI to be checked automatically by OpenAEV simulations.

components.name: Share with organizations
components.description: Share with organizations within the platform

fields.label: Share all elements included in the bundle

components.summary: Shares the elements in scope with the organizations you select.
components.use_when: you distribute intelligence to member organizations automatically.
notes: Your platform needs a main organization, set in Settings > Security > Policies.
The component reads the database before the ingestion step. An element created earlier in the same playbook does not exist yet, so the step fails. Share it from a second playbook.

From 7.261119, an organization that no longer exists on the platform (deleted since, or named by a playbook imported from another platform) shows as "<name> - deleted" in Target organizations, with the message "A selected item no longer exists: remove it and pick another". Replace it to set the step again.

components.name: Unshare with organizations
components.description: Unshare with organizations within the platform

fields.label: Unshare all elements included in the bundle

components.summary: Stops sharing the elements in scope with the organizations you select.
components.use_when: an element must no longer be visible to an organization.
notes: Place unsharing before any sharing step, or in its own playbook, so the two do not conflict.
Like sharing, it reads the database before ingestion and fails on elements created in the same playbook.
From 7.261119, an organization that no longer exists on the platform shows as "<name> - deleted" in Target organizations, as for sharing. Replace it to set the step again.

components.name: Manage access restrictions
components.description: Manage advanced access restrictions on entities

fields.label: Apply access restrictions on all elements included in the bundle

components.summary: Restricts access to containers and organization entities to the authorized members you set, either fixed users, groups and organizations, or taken from the data (author, creator, assignees, participants, organizations in the bundle).
components.use_when: a case or report must only be visible to the people working on it.
notes: For other entity types, share with organizations instead.
The component reads the database before ingestion. Restrict access to a container created in the same playbook from a second playbook.

components.name: Remove access restrictions
components.description: Remove advanced access restrictions on entities

fields.label: Remove access restrictions on all elements included in the bundle

components.summary: Removes authorized-member restrictions from containers and organization entities in scope.
components.use_when: a restricted container must be opened to everyone who can otherwise see it.

components.name: Apply predefined rule
components.description: Execute advanced predefined computing

ports.meaning: at least one element was changed or matched
nothing was changed and the bundle passes through as received

fields.label: Rule to apply
values: First/Last seen computing extension from report publication date
Resolve indicators based on observables (add in bundle)
Resolve observables an indicator is based on (add in bundle)
Resolve neighbors relations and entities (add in bundle)
Resolve containers containing the entity (add in bundle)

components.summary: Applies one built-in inference rule to the bundle, for example to add the observables an indicator is based on, or the content of a container.
components.use_when: later steps need related elements that are not in the triggering event.
notes: You cannot chain two rules in the same playbook. The playbook stops at the second one.
Rules can be expensive on large containers.

components.name: Send to notifier
components.description: Send user notification
components.summary: Sends a notification through the notifier you choose, to fixed recipients or to people taken from the data. It ends the branch and saves nothing.
components.use_when: people must be told about what the playbook found.
notes: To both notify and save, add a second branch from the same parent ending with Send for ingestion.

Besides fixed users, groups and organizations, Targets offers dynamic recipients: Author (organization), the users of the organization that authored the element, Creators, Assignees and Participants, all read from the elements set in Resolve dynamic targets from, and Organizations, the users of every organization in the bundle.

components.name: Promote observable to indicator
components.description: Create an indicator based on an observable

ports.meaning: at least one element was changed or matched
nothing was changed and the bundle passes through as received

fields.label: Create indicators from all observables in the bundle
If main entity is a container, wrap indicators in container

components.summary: Creates an indicator from each observable in scope.
components.use_when: observables from a trusted source should become detection content.
notes: When the main element is a container, you can add the new indicators and their relationships to it.

components.name: Reduce knowledge
components.description: Reduce STIX data according to the filter (keep only matching)

ports.meaning: at least one element was changed or matched
no element matched the filters and the bundle passes through unchanged

components.summary: Removes from the bundle every element that does not match the filters. The main element is always kept.
components.use_when: a rule or a connector added more elements than the next steps should handle.
notes: Because the main element is always kept, set later steps to "All elements except the main one" when they should touch only what was kept.

components.name: Extract observables from indicator
components.description: Create observables based on an indicator

ports.meaning: at least one element was changed or matched
nothing was changed and the bundle passes through as received

fields.label: Create observables from all indicators in the bundle
If main entity is a container, wrap observables in container

components.summary: Creates the observables described by each indicator pattern in scope.
components.use_when: you need observables to enrich or pivot on, starting from indicators.
notes: When the main element is a container, you can add the new observables and their relationships to it.

components.name: Send email from template
components.description: Send email from template to targets
components.summary: Sends an email built from one of your email templates, to fixed recipients or to people taken from the data.
components.use_when: the message needs your own wording and layout.
notes: Besides fixed users, groups and organizations, Targets offers dynamic recipients: Author (organization), the users of the organization that authored the element, Creators, Assignees and Participants, all read from the elements set in Resolve dynamic targets from, and Organizations, the users of every organization in the bundle.
